name: switch_background_music_channel

stack.evidence: func_001E9110 consumes a one-based channel, target volume percentage, and duration, stops the current D_002BD8B4 music channel through func_0011C608, converts the selected channel to zero-based, scales volume to the 0x3000 sound range and duration by eight, and starts the selected channel through func_0011C5D8

notes: The sole JP call occurs in al02.ard after command 719 suppress_automatic_battle_music_switching and passes channel 2, volume 100, and duration 40 before an enemy-wave sequence.
